proposal.description: The soft-start window and count are also cleared on the clock after window_trip_SS fires, as if the trip itself should start a clean soft-start window, instead of being cleared only when neither S_SS nor S_RUN is active.
proposal.reason: In S_SS, once fault_count_ss reaches trip_ss, window_trip_SS is high for one clock only and then drops, even though the window still holds trip_ss faulted cycles. On the next clock fault_count_ss_out reads 0 instead of the trip count, and through S_RUN it keeps reading 0 instead of the held soft-start count.
